Senses.Explanation: To open the winter assembly is to begin the monastery’s winter period of gathered teaching, questioning, and communal observance. Records use the term both as an institutional event heading and as an action in Xueguang’s biography: Xueguang winters at Jingde, while the records of Shiqi Tongyun and Hanxiu Ruqian mark the winter opening immediately before a hall address. The event can be formally sponsored. Muchen Daomin’s Northern Journey Collection records an imperial command to open the hall and winter assembly, with court officers carrying incense before Muchen Daomin takes the seat. The winter assembly also becomes a public question. Yulin Tongxiu asks the gathered community what will keep this winter from betraying their lives; Ruibai Mingxue says a general tea was prepared because of the winter assembly and asks what the monastery will offer its arrivals. The term names the institutional opening, not a weather description and not a private exercise. Closely related opening and closing formulas remain separate entries or cross-references.
